actions.description: Create a folder in the personal OneDrive
actions.name: create-folder

parentItemId.description: The ID of the parent item (folder) where the new folder should be created. Example: "root" or "01A1B2C3D4E5F6G7H8I9J0K"

folderName.description: The name for the new folder. Example: "My New Folder"

conflictBehavior.description: The conflict behavior if a folder with the same name exists. Default is "rename".

id.description: The ID of the newly created folder

name.description: The name of the created folder

actions.description: Create a share link for a file or folder in OneDrive.
actions.name: create-sharing-link

item_id.description: The ID of the drive item (file or folder) to share. Example: "0123456789abc!123"

type.description: The type of sharing link to create. "view" allows read-only access, "edit" allows read-write access.

scope.description: The scope of the sharing link. "anonymous" allows anyone with the link to access (no sign-in required), "users" restricts to existing organization users.

id.description: The unique ID of the permission created.

webUrl.description: The URL that can be used to access the shared item.

share_id.description: A unique token for the share link.

roles.description: The set of roles granted by the permission.

actions.description: Start a resumable upload session for a large file to OneDrive personal drive.
actions.name: create-upload-session

parent_item_id.description: The ID of the parent folder where the file will be uploaded. Example: "01ABCDEF123456789"

file_name.description: The name of the file to be uploaded. Example: "document.pdf"

file_system_info.description: Optional file system info for the file.

created_date_time.description: Optional created date time in ISO 8601 format.

last_modified_date_time.description: Optional last modified date time in ISO 8601 format.

upload_url.description: The URL endpoint for uploading file bytes via byte-range PUT requests.

expiration_date_time.description: The expiration date/time in ISO 8601 format for the upload session.

next_expected_ranges.description: Zero or more byte ranges indicating what data has been received.

actions.description: Delete a file or folder from OneDrive
actions.name: delete-item

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item to delete. Example: "0123456789abc"

success.description: Whether the item was successfully deleted

itemId.description: The ID of the deleted item

actions.description: Remove a sharing permission from an item.
actions.name: delete-permission

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item. Example: "0123456789abc"

permissionId.description: The ID of the permission to delete. Example: "b123456789ab!123"

actions.description: Download the binary content of a file
actions.name: download-item-content

item_id.description: The ID of the file item to download. Example: "01A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9I0J1K2L3M4N5O6P7Q8R9S0T1U2V3W4X5Y6Z7A8B9C0D1E2F3"

content.description: Base64-encoded binary content of the file

content_type.description: MIME type of the file content

size.description: Size of the file content in bytes

actions.description: Retrieve a file or folder by ID or path.
actions.name: get-item

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item to retrieve. Example: "123ABC"

path.description: The path to the drive item from the root. Example: "/Documents/file.txt"

id.description: The unique identifier of the item

size.description: Size of the file in bytes

createdDateTime.description: Date and time of item creation

lastModifiedDateTime.description: Date and time the item was last modified

webUrl.description: URL to view the item in OneDrive

downloadUrl.description: URL to download the file content

file.description: File metadata if this is a file

folder.description: Folder metadata if this is a folder

actions.description: Retrieve a sharing permission on an item.
actions.name: get-permission

itemId.description: The ID of the driveItem. Example: "12345ABC!123"

permissionId.description: The ID of the permission to retrieve. Example: "1"

actions.description: Grant item access to recipients and optionally send invitations.
actions.name: invite-recipients

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item to grant access to. Example: "0123456789ABC!123"

email.description: Email address of the recipient. Example: "user@example.com"

recipients.description: List of recipients to invite. For personal accounts, use email addresses only.

roles.description: Roles to grant to the recipients. Values: "read", "write".

sendInvitation.description: Whether to send an invitation email to the recipients. Defaults to true.

requireSignIn.description: Whether the recipient is required to sign in to access the item. Defaults to false.

permissions.description: List of permissions granted to the recipients.

actions.description: List items under a folder in OneDrive Personal.
actions.name: list-children

itemId.description: The ID of the folder to list children for. Omit to list children of the root folder. Example: "01ABC123DEF456"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (@odata.nextLink) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List sharing permissions on an item
actions.name: list-permissions

itemId.description: The ID of the drive item to list permissions for. Example: "123ABC!456"
The ID of the file item. Example: "0123456789abc"

actions.description: Move or rename a file or folder in OneDrive Personal.
actions.name: move-item

item_id.description: The ID of the driveItem to move or rename. Example: "0123456789abc!123"

parent_reference.description: Reference to the new parent folder for moving the item. Provide either id or path.

id.description: The ID of the new parent folder. Example: "0123456789abc!456"

path.description: The path to the new parent folder. Example: "/drive/root:/NewFolder"

name.description: The new name for the item. Example: "NewFileName.txt"

cursor.description: Pagination link from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

id.description: The unique identifier of the item.

size.description: The size of the item in bytes.

created_at.description: The date and time the item was created.

modified_at.description: The date and time the item was last modified.

web_url.description: The URL to view the item in OneDrive.

is_folder.description: Whether the item is a folder.

is_file.description: Whether the item is a file.

parent_id.description: The ID of the parent folder.

is_deleted.description: Whether the item has been deleted.

items.description: Array of drive items matching the search query.

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

actions.description: Update mutable file or folder metadata.
actions.name: update-item

itemId.description: The unique identifier of the drive item to update. Example: "0123456789abc"

description.description: New description for the item. Use null to clear.

parentReference.description: New parent folder reference to move the item.

id.description: The ID of the parent folder.

driveId.description: The ID of the drive containing the parent folder.

createdDateTime.description: The UTC date and time the file was created on the client.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: The UTC date and time the file was last modified on the client.

actions.description: Upload a small file in a single request.
actions.name: upload-small-file

parentItemId.description: The ID of the parent item (folder) where the file will be uploaded. Example: "root" or a specific item ID.

fileName.description: The name of the file to be uploaded. Example: "document.txt"

content.description: The base64-encoded content of the file to upload. Always base64 encode the content before passing it here.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the file content. Defaults to "text/plain" if not provided. Example: "application/json"

syncs.description: Sync selected OneDrive files from metadata
syncs.name: user-files-selection

syncs.description: Sync file metadata from the personal OneDrive
syncs.name: user-files
